baslik: The Nuclear Test That Poisoned a Paradise Forever
aciklama:
In 1946 the US detonated an atomic bomb underwater at Bikini Atoll - the test that contaminated an entire fleet and left a paradise uninhabitable to this day.

#shorts #history #nuclear #disaster #coldwar

sahneler.metin: This was the moment the atomic age poisoned a paradise.
The year is 1946, at Bikini Atoll in the middle of the Pacific.
The United States moves the islanders out, just for a little while, they promise.
Then it detonates an atomic bomb underwater, beneath a fleet of warships.
A column of radioactive water, two million tons heavy, climbs into the sky.
It crashes back down and coats every ship in deadly radiation.
The contamination is so bad the fleet can never be cleaned.
The islanders were never allowed to return to their home.
Almost eighty years later, Bikini is still too radioactive to live on.
